_note: compliance-gate owns this file. Every value must carry a source URL + verified_on date before ship. Code reads it through lib/ramza/rules.ts — never hardcode these numbers elsewhere.

campaign._how: DEADLINE mode through deadline_mode_until (Dubai day), RESCUE mode through rescue_mode_until, then evergreen. See rulesMode() in lib/ramza/rules.ts.

partner.role: Licensed partner that files returns on EmaraTax and issues the filing invoice
partner.VERIFY: compliance-gate: confirm Lexoro Solutions' licence / tax-agent registration number for the footer before paid traffic

ct.filing_rule: Return + payment due within 9 months of tax period end

late_filing_penalty.legal_basis: Cabinet Decision No. 75 of 2023 (Corporate Tax administrative penalties)
late_filing_penalty.verified_note: Cabinet Decision No. 129 of 2025 (eff. 14 Apr 2026) amends Cabinet Decision No. 40 of 2017 for VAT/Excise only — it aligns those with the CT regime and does NOT change CT late-filing amounts.
late_filing_penalty.VERIFY: compliance-gate: confirm Cabinet Decision 75/2023 schedule on tax.gov.ae (primary source) before the estimator ships in paid traffic

late_registration_waiver.rule: Penalty waived (or refunded as credit) if the FIRST tax return / annual declaration is filed within 7 months of the end of the first tax period. First tax period only.
late_registration_waiver.effect_for_dec_2025_year_end: Window closed 2026-07-31 — do NOT pitch the waiver as available to Dec-2025 year-end businesses in this campaign.
late_registration_waiver.status: Initiative active per FTA news, May 2026

rate.legal_basis: Federal Decree-Law No. 47 of 2022, Cabinet Decision No. 116 of 2023

registration.rule_before_2024_03_01: Resident juridical person existing before 1 Mar 2024: deadline by the MONTH of its earliest licence's issue date (any year)
registration.rule_on_or_after_2024_03_01: Resident juridical person (incl. Free Zone Person) incorporated on/after 1 Mar 2024: within 3 months of incorporation
registration.legal_basis: FTA Decision No. 3 of 2024, Article 3 (penalty per Article 6 → Cabinet Decision No. 75 of 2023)

excluded: member of a Multinational Enterprise Group
small_business_relief.legal_basis: Ministerial Decision No. 73 of 2023, end date extended by Ministerial Decision No. 131 (Aug 2026)

natural_person.rule: A natural person's business is subject to CT only when its turnover exceeds AED 1m in a Gregorian calendar year (wages, personal investment and real-estate investment income never count)

registration.basis: taxable supplies + imports in the past 12 months, or expected in the next 30 days

penalties.legal_basis: Cabinet Decision No. 129 of 2025 (effective 14 Apr 2026), amending Cabinet Decision No. 40 of 2017
penalties.VERIFY: compliance-gate: secondary sources only — confirm amounts on tax.gov.ae (Cabinet Decision 129/2025 text) before paid traffic

einvoicing.scope: B2B/B2G; B2C-only currently out of scope
einvoicing.VERIFY: compliance-gate: confirm 'B2C-only out of scope' on mof.gov.ae before using it in copy

pricing._status: Tier model decided (transaction-based). Tier AED amounts still null = founder to set; UI shows 'Get a quote' until then.

one_off._decided: Rescue fee AED 4,999 one-off — founder decision 2026-09-28

pricing.model: transaction-based: billable txn = bank lines + ceil(gateway lines / gateway_lines_per_txn), priced by tier
